note: Local P0 registry. Operator-authored. In P1 this is served by the catalog API and every entry carries a content hash.

games.title: Sprout Speedway
games.summary: A three-lap car race round a big floating loop: launch over the gap, ride the hills, hit the speed strip. Race your friends in a party.

games.title: Garden Dash
games.summary: Collect five seeds and reach the exit. About a minute.

games.title: Rooftop Run
games.summary: Four checkpoints, one clock, no safety net.

games.title: Sky Tycoon
games.summary: Run three droppers on a floating plot, buy upgrades, then buy the crown to open the exit. Your plot is kept between visits.

games.title: Blaster Bay
games.summary: A beach range with targets, patrolling crabs and a turret on the tower. Score 100 points to open the exit.

games.title: Launch Pad Leap
games.summary: Launch pads, lifts and a pocket of floaty air. Hit four checkpoints in order and reach the summit.

games.title: Lava Escape
games.summary: Hop the stones over lava, run the spiky bridge and climb to the tower. Three hearts, three lives.

games.title: Seed Frenzy
games.summary: Sixty seconds, eighteen seeds, three launch pads. Grab 300 points to win, or set a best score.

games.title: Teleport Towers
games.summary: Five floating towers, five teleporters, six seeds. Collect them all, then reach the exit at the hub.

games.title: Hollow House
games.summary: A dark house, a flashlight and five candles. The front door shuts behind you until you find them all. Spooky, with sudden sounds.

games.title: Sky Circuit
games.summary: A three-lap race round a floating loop: four gates, a launch over the gap, a speed strip and bumpers. Race your friends in a party.

games.title: Seed Squad
games.summary: Three rounds of 45 seconds: grab seeds for your team. Points add up over the rounds. Best with a party.

games.title: Plot Tycoon
games.summary: Four plots, one each: join any time, run your droppers, buy upgrades and a crown. Your plot is kept between visits.

games.title: Tag Island
games.summary: Party tag over three rounds: walls to dodge round, launch pads and a teleporter. Least time as "it" wins. Needs a party.

games.title: Hide and Seek Woods
games.summary: Party hide-and-seek: huts, walls, crates, a lookout tower and a lot of trees. Found players join the seekers. Needs a party.

games.title: Vault Run
games.summary: Find the red key, clear two crab waves for the gold key, and crack the vault. Objectives tick off as you go.
